parsed.note_claim: The videos and incident are from the January 2 2024 runway collision at Tokyo Haneda Airport.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: A video appears to show the terror of passengers inside a Japan Airlines plane that was engulfed in flames as it landed on a runway at Tokyo's Haneda Airport.
parsed.reason: The article confirms the videos depict the Japan Airlines plane incident on a runway at Tokyo's Haneda Airport, published on January 2, 2024.
